parameters.specification/query:
// DAX Query
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Not Delivered"}, 'Oil Delivery'[DeliveryStatus])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({"Not Confirmed"}, 'Oil Delivery'[OrderStatus])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable3 = 
		TREATAS({"COT",
			"Billed"}, 'Oil Delivery'[Status])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		CALCULATETABLE(
			SUMMARIZE(
				'Oil Delivery',
				'Oil Delivery'[Address],
				'Oil Delivery'[DeliveryDate],
				'Oil Delivery'[DeliveryNote],
				'Oil Delivery'[DeliveryStatus],
				'Oil Delivery'[Distributor],
				'Oil Delivery'[Eircode],
				'Oil Delivery'[FillRestriction],
				'Oil Delivery'[FuelType],
				'Oil Delivery'[LatestVolumePercent],
				'Oil Delivery'[Mobile],
				'Oil Delivery'[MPRN],
				'Oil Delivery'[LatestVolumeReading],
				'Oil Delivery'[Name],
				'Oil Delivery'[OrderStatus],
				'Oil Delivery'[PropertyType],
				'Oil Delivery'[Status],
				'Oil Delivery'[SubmitDate],
				'Oil Delivery'[TankID],
				'Oil Delivery'[AssignedAgent],
				'Oil Delivery'[Capacity],
				'Oil Delivery'[ContactStrikes],
				'Oil Delivery'[CRN],
				'Oil Delivery'[ID],
				'Oil Delivery'[TotalCount],
				'Oil Delivery'[Volume]
			),
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable),
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable2),
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable3)
		)


EVALUATE
	__DS0Core 

ORDER BY
	'Oil Delivery'[DeliveryDate],
	'Oil Delivery'[Address],
	'Oil Delivery'[DeliveryNote],
	'Oil Delivery'[DeliveryStatus],
	'Oil Delivery'[Distributor],
	'Oil Delivery'[Eircode],
	'Oil Delivery'[FillRestriction],
	'Oil Delivery'[FuelType],
	'Oil Delivery'[LatestVolumePercent],
	'Oil Delivery'[Mobile],
	'Oil Delivery'[MPRN],
	'Oil Delivery'[LatestVolumeReading],
	'Oil Delivery'[Name],
	'Oil Delivery'[OrderStatus],
	'Oil Delivery'[PropertyType],
	'Oil Delivery'[Status],
	'Oil Delivery'[SubmitDate],
	'Oil Delivery'[TankID],
	'Oil Delivery'[AssignedAgent],
	'Oil Delivery'[Capacity],
	'Oil Delivery'[ContactStrikes],
	'Oil Delivery'[CRN],
	'Oil Delivery'[ID],
	'Oil Delivery'[TotalCount],
	'Oil Delivery'[Volume]

// DAX Query
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Customers Address'[CustomerID])),
			'Customers Address'[CustomerID] = @{items('Apply_to_each')['CRN']}
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		CALCULATETABLE(
			SUMMARIZE(
				'Customers Address',
				'Customers Address'[CustomerID],
				'Customers Address'[FullAddress],
				'Customers Address'[FirstName],
				'Customers Address'[MobileNo],
				'Customers Address'[SMSAllowed],
				'Customers Address'[CustomerRef]
			),
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable)
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Core 

ORDER BY
	'Customers Address'[CustomerID],
	'Customers Address'[FullAddress],
	'Customers Address'[FirstName],
	'Customers Address'[MobileNo],
	'Customers Address'[SMSAllowed],
	'Customers Address'[CustomerRef]
